_comment: Mods each in-game scenario installs, pinned by CKAN identifier and version (CKAN resolves dependencies; versions checked against a working KSP 1.12.5 install on 13/11/2026). Squad and SquadExpansion come with the game. KSPCommunityFixes is left out on purpose: without a real screen its cache step hangs (see docs/TESTING.md).

minimal.purpose: Scribe alone with the stock game: transactions, revert, flight, docking, benchmark, menu, noscribe

contracts.purpose: Contracts accepted and completed (F10): the stock contract system plus Contract Configurator

kct.purpose: Technology unlocked and facility upgraded through Kerbal Construction Time (F11)

full-career.purpose: Optional, local only: the whole 143-mod career install, to catch conflicts. Not reproducible by others
